occurrences.source_excerpt: Manual Muscle Testing (MMT) • Assessment of muscle strength • Manual muscle testing is a procedure for the evaluation of the function and strength of individual muscles and muscle groups based on the effective performance of a movement in relation to the forces of gravity and manual resistance. • Dynamometry is a method of strength testing using sophisticated strength measuring devices (e.g., hand-grip, hand- held, fixed, and isokinetic dynamometry).

occurrences.source_excerpt: How to perform MMT • Patients are asked to hold a position against a therapist’s resistance. • It is important to stabilize proximal part of the area being tested to reduce compensatory action by muscles other than those being tested • Resistance needs to be applied gradually ("meet my resistance" or "don't let me move you") in the opposite direction of muscle being tested • Both sides should be tested to provide a comparison

occurrences.source_excerpt:
Manual Muscle Testing (MMT)
• Assessment of muscle strength
• Manual muscle testing is a procedure for the evaluation of the function and strength of individual muscles and muscle groups based on the effective performance of a movement in relation to the forces of gravity and manual resistance.
• Dynamometry is a method of strength testing using sophisticated strength measuring devices (e.g., hand-grip, hand- held, fixed, and isokinetic dynamometry).

source_pages.formatted: 21 - 7.1 Manual Muscle Testing 手動肌肉測試.pdf, slide 5 (PDF p. 5)

occurrences.source_excerpt:
How to perform MMT
• Patients are asked to hold a position against a therapist’s resistance.
• It is important to stabilize proximal part of the area being tested to reduce compensatory action by muscles other than those being tested
• Resistance needs to be applied gradually ("meet my resistance" or "don't let me move you") in the opposite direction of muscle being tested
• Both sides should be tested to provide a comparison
